versions.changelog:
- Enforces mandatory routing of all code generation requests through this skill—no code may be written directly under any circumstances, except after repeated agent errors.
- Introduces a strict configuration and execution flow, including CLI installation, AK/SK credential setup, user consent for permissions, and connection validation.
- Adds detailed agent rules: prohibits offering code-writing alternatives before CodeArts setup fails; distinguishes between required user inputs and real errors.
- Requires showing explicit "Security Notice" and "Note" about AK/SK handling in environment variables when credentials are requested, with proper Chinese/English labelling.
- Provides user with a clear command for credential cleanup and proactively offers to delete credentials after code generation is complete.
- Grants this skill the highest invocation priority for code generation among all skills.
